punchline: Marcus Aurelius listed the annoying people he would meet that day, then reminded himself they were his kin.
thirty_sec: In a camp among the Quadi by the Danube, Marcus Aurelius wrote himself a morning rehearsal: today you will meet the ungrateful, the envious, the false. They act out of ignorance, he reminded himself, and they share his reason, so he cannot be hurt by them or angry at them. People were made to work together, like hands, feet and rows of teeth.
